import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        B = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        max_val = 0
        seen = set()
        for i in range(N):
            if B[i] > max_val:
                max_val = B[i]
            if B[i] != 1:
                seen.add(B[i])
        if len(seen) > 1 or (len(seen) == 1 and max_val != 1):
            results.append("NO")
        else:
            results.append("YES")
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
